name: Cached Forager v3
hypothesis: The previous mandatory deposit rules cause agents to carry empty loads or rest prematurely due to rigid synchronization; adding a 'carrying' condition specifically to trigger 'deposit' only when cargo is full prevents unnecessary stops at non-full locations, allowing faster travel between food patches while still ensuring all harvested items are stored upon arrival.
